---
title: "Trump 2.0 Trade policy diary"
description: "Ontario surcharges US electricity exports; Trump retaliates with more steel and aluminium tariffs on Canada, testing the theory that trade barriers breed conflict."
date: "2025-03-11"
categories: [trade-wars]
---

On March 11, 2025, Ontario responded to US tariffs with a 25% surcharge on
electricity exports to the US, prompting Trump to escalate with a further 25%
tariff on Canadian steel and aluminium. The stakes are high given Canada
supplies roughly 32% of US steel and aluminium imports (about $19 billion a
year), risking real inflationary pressure across US industry. Trump also
threatened 25% tariffs on Canadian vehicles and parts and demanded lower
Canadian dairy tariffs. The post notes the episode is a live test of the
political-science claim that protectionism tends to raise, not lower,
conflict between trading partners.

**Originally published on Substack**, March 11, 2025.
